updates.title: 💡 Pro AI Tip #1
updates.description: Always use 'Chain of Thought' prompting. Tell the AI to 'Think step-by-step' for 90% better results.

updates.title: Sora Video Engine
updates.description: Create high-fidelity 60fps cinematic videos directly from text. Now with natively generated audio.

updates.title: 💡 Pro AI Tip #2
updates.description: Use 'Few-Shot Prompting' by giving the AI 2-3 examples of the output you want before asking your question.

updates.title: Midjourney V7
updates.description: New hyper-realistic lighting engine. Perfect for architectural visualization and product design.

updates.title: 💡 Pro AI Tip #3
updates.description: To avoid AI hallucinations, ask the AI to 'Cite your sources' or 'Double-check your logic' at the end of the prompt.
